name: – § 1, point o – Am 11
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a special committee on the Housing Crisis in the European Union, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office
part_text: (o) to conduct hearings with experts from the Union institutions and competent authorities, international, national and regional institutions, non-governmental organisations, tenant organisations and relevant sectors of the economy, taking into account the perspectives of a range of stakeholders;
